mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, summary, improvement, retry_advice, remark, created_at, updated_at FROM session_retrospective WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO session_retrospective(session_id, summary, improvement, retry_advice, remark) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{summary}, #{improvement}, #{retryAdvice}, #{remark}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE summary = VALUES(summary), improvement = VALUES(improvement), retry_advice = VALUES(retry_advice), remark = VALUES(remark), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
